question: What are Qnami's main strengths? Give short bullet points
answer:
Here are Qnami’s main strengths, summarized in concise bullet points:

• Pioneer and global leader in quantum sensing and imaging technologies, particularly in scanning NV (nitrogen-vacancy) magnetometry ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/?utm_source=openai))  
• Developed the first commercial scanning NV magnetometer, ProteusQ™, enabling atomic-scale magnetic field mapping ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2024/02/02/qnami-expands-into-japan-and-south-korea/?utm_source=openai))  
• Proprietary Quantilever™ diamond scanning probes offering nanoscale sensitivity, robustness, and biocompatibility ([eu.36kr.com](https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3478991309838724?utm_source=openai))  
• Integrated end-to-end solution: hardware (probe + microscope), software (LabQ built on open-source Qudi), and analysis tools for ease of use and customization ([eu.36kr.com](https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3478991309838724?utm_source=openai))  
• Strong academic and industrial collaborations, with installations at leading research institutions and expansion into markets like Japan, South Korea, and Scandinavia ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2024/02/02/qnami-expands-into-japan-and-south-korea/?utm_source=openai))  
• Recognized by investors and innovation programs: successful seed and Series A funding rounds, inclusion in “Top 100 Swiss Startups,” and backing from deep-tech VCs ([htgf.de](https://www.htgf.de/en/qnami-closes-chf-2-6m-seed-financing-round/?utm_source=openai))
